chunks: Certainly, our case is difficult and complicated. No one can bear it except a believer whose heart Allāh has tried with belief. Our traditions will not be preserved except by trustworthy hearts and (men of) solid understanding.

key_terms.أَمْرُنَا: Our case / our matter (referring to the Imams)

ai.seo_question: What qualities are required to bear the weight of the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi frames this difficulty not merely as intellectual complexity but as a spiritual trial (imtahan) specific to the Ahl al-Bayt's esoteric teachings, requiring both emotional purity ('trustworthy hearts') and cognitive stability ('solid intellects'). This distinction underscores the Shia concept that true understanding of the Imam's guidance demands a divinely prepared vessel, linking the burden of knowledge to the purity of the recipient's soul.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Certainly, our case is difficult and complicated. No one can bear it except a believer whose heart Allāh has tried with belief. Our traditions will not be preserved except by trustworthy hearts and (men of) solid understanding.
